Kupo Skribbl · FFXIV Pictionary for Dalamud

A Pictionary-style drawing and guessing game inside Final Fantasy XIV for 2–16 players.

Install in Dalamud · How to play · What's new · Feedback & help

| Multiplayer | Profiles | Word lists | | --- | --- | --- | | Private rooms, public lobbies and friend invitations. | Custom drawn portraits and optional leaderboards. | FFXIV, everyday objects, memes, video games and custom words. | Requires **Dalamud / XIVLauncher**. Connects automatically to our shared server. ## Install in Dalamud 1. Open **Dalamud Settings → Experimental → Custom Plugin Repositories**. 2. Paste this address, add it and save: ```text https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudesh/kupopop/main/plugin/releases/repo.json ``` 3. Find **Kupo Skribbl** in the plugin installer and install it. 4. Open with **`/kupo`**, **`/kuposkribbl`** or **`/kupopop`**. Create a profile and save your recovery code somewhere private. Never share it. **Unofficial plugin:** not listed in the official Dalamud repository. Each player needs the plugin installed. ## How to play 1. Join via code, host a room or browse public lobbies. 2. On your turn, choose a word and draw it. 3. Guess in chat. Earlier correct guesses earn more points; correct guesses also reward the drawer. 4. The highest score after the final round wins. Hosts choose the timer, rounds and word lists. Custom-word matches are unranked. Join an ongoing match to guess immediately and draw from the next round (or next match if it is the final round). Right-click a player to add a friend or view their shared profile. Send invitations from **Friends**. ## Privacy Closing the plugin leaves your room and disconnects you. Optional background invitation checks run once a minute and never reopen it automatically. Choose whether to record statistics, share your profile and receive background invitations during setup or in **Profile → Privacy & invitations**. Shared profiles are visible to friends and people you played with; there is no player search. Recorded statistics appear on leaderboards with your portrait and an anonymous name by default. A recognisable portrait can identify you. You can show your name, hide your portrait, leave leaderboards, or reset/disable statistics. ## Feedback [Report a bug](https://github.com/cloudesh/kupopop/issues) with your plugin version and steps to reproduce it. Use **Suggestions** in the plugin for ideas or new words. Never include credentials or private chat. For contributors: [build and architecture guide](DEVELOPMENT.md) · [release notes](https://github.com/cloudesh/kupopop/releases) · [licenses and notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). The download badge counts downloads, not unique players. Not affiliated with Square Enix or skribbl.io.
